design: ABBA, same built JAR, Forge 47.4.23, Java 17, seed 8675309, identical fresh chunk coordinates, 7 x 64-chunk samples per run

terrain_hash_gate.reason: The benchmark used Block.getId(BlockState) in its post-timing hash. The hash differed between baseline A1 and baseline A2 themselves at identical seed/coordinates, so that cross-JVM numeric-ID hash cannot be used as semantic-parity proof. No claim of terrain parity is made from this gate.
terrain_hash_gate.safety_action: The Cache2D fill optimization is retained as an experimental option but defaults OFF in 2.2.0. The normal release profile therefore preserves the previously validated 1.20.1 world-generation path.
